Board settings keep drifting between services

Status
recurring
Symptom
settings-drift
First seen
2026-01-12
Last seen
2026-05-04
Equipment
Main sound board

What's happening

Almost every Sunday, the board has been changed since last service. Faders are in different positions, some channels are muted that shouldn't be, and the monitor mix is different. Volunteers spend 10-15 minutes resetting before the service starts.

What's been tried

  • Took a phone photo of the board after the Sunday service in January
  • Started asking the other congregation's sound team to recall scene 1 after their service

This is the most painful recurring issue we have. It’s the main reason we built this site.

Suggestion

No approved suggestion exists for this symptom yet. A rule exists but is still in draft — it needs a reviewer's approval. Try the symptom page or ask an experienced volunteer.

Suggestions on this site are guidance, not professional advice. If you are unsure, stop and ask an experienced sound engineer.
